note: What a server sends to change or reset the voice a unit speaks with. The header names the unit.

fields.name: reset
fields.note: Whether to reset. A name follows any value other than 1, so a server sends only 0 or 1.

1.name: reset
1.note: The unit returns to its own voice; nothing follows.

fields.name: voice
fields.note: The voice's name, ended by a zero byte.

fields.name: flags

bits.name: reset
bits.note: Set where the unit returns to its own voice; no name follows.

bits.name: unused
bits.note: Unused; a server writes zero.

fields.note: Whether to reset. A client compares the whole byte with 1, so a server writes the other bits zero.
